children: Germany's financial watchdog Bafin said on Friday that it had set Deutsche Bank
new deadlines to remedy deficiencies in data-processing systems used to monitor transactions for money laundering and terrorist financing.
Deutsche Bank said it was committed to complying with the order, which the lender said related to previous orders in 2021 and 2023.
Germany's largest lender has over the years had a variety of compliance issues that it has been working to improve.
